name: kernel-opt-agent
description: GPU kernel knowledge-base, benchmarking, and profiling skills for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: GPU kernel KBS retrieval, benchmarking, and NCU profiling workflows.
interface.longDescription: Installs kernel_KBS, kernel_benchmark, and kernel_profile: a corpus-backed GPU kernel knowledge base, PyTorch-reference benchmarking for CUDA/CUTLASS/CuTe DSL/Triton kernels, plus local correctness, Nsight Compute profiling, and bottleneck diagnosis workflows.
defaultPrompt: Search kernel_KBS for Blackwell NVFP4 GEMM patterns.
Benchmark this Triton kernel against a PyTorch reference.
Profile this Triton kernel and classify its bottleneck.
Find source-backed CUDA optimization ideas for this kernel.
